title: Packets timing tests do not execute network and adoption trust vectors
description: Correctness review: test_packets_timing claims to execute committed trust vectors but never drives network_cases or time_adoption through production. It only reasserts stored expected booleans, so unauthorized peer, option mismatch, replay high-water, accuracy, lower-stratum, and below-floor outcomes can drift unnoticed. Make every vector a complete input executed against production and assert one-to-one case/category coverage plus exact rejection reasons.
